name: artwork_one
description: Artwork One: a cover-led interface for Volumio. The cover of what plays fills the screen; every control floats above it.
author: Michal Tamas

volumio_info.details: A cover-led interface for Volumio: the cover of what plays fills the screen, softly blurred, and every control floats above it on frosted glass. Three faces of Now Playing (cover, info, lyrics), an ambient display for the player's own screen, a labelled rail, Zones, and every Volumio source and setting as before. After enabling, pick Artwork One under Settings → System → User Interface layout design (or press Switch on this page).
volumio_info.changelog: 3.2.2: Check Updates shows its answer and the update its progress, as in Volumio's own interfaces; Wi-Fi in the first-run wizard connects through the wizard (no cut-off over the hotspot); Home · Library tabs; "Add a source" opens Settings → Sources. Includes 3.2.1: plugin settings and dialogs as in Volumio (FusionDsp values, progress dialogs, Spotify sign-in), DAC Model and output names, folder view.
